description: A named pair \(U,V\) is inseparable when no formula in the common language, with shared names in \(\mathbb N\), has opposite derivable truth values on the two sides.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.JointConsistency.NamedInseparable.{u, v} {L₀ L₁ L₂ : FirstOrder.Language} (j₁ : L₀ →ᴸ L₁)
  (j₂ : L₀ →ᴸ L₂) (U : Set (L₁.Formula ℕ)) (V : Set (L₂.Formula ℕ)) : Prop
